item.title: 'We never asked for a ceasefire,' says Iran's foreign minister, as war keeps raging
item.summary: Israel announced a barrage of new strikes on western Iran on Sunday, while Iran's foreign minister said the country has not asked for a ceasefire as President Trump had claimed.

item.title: 'One Battle After Another' takes best picture. Here's the full list of Oscar winners
item.summary: Michael B. Jordan and Jessie Buckley won best actor and best actress. Paul Thomas Anderson received best director. Cassandra Kulukundis won the Academy's first ever casting award.

item.title: Acclaimed 20th century philosopher Jürgen Habermas dies at 96
item.summary: Associated with the Frankfurt School, Habermas was a world-renowned thinker on modernity and democracy who helped shape German post-war and post-reunification political discourse.

item.title: Pentagon tightens controls over Stars and Stripes after calling it "woke"
item.summary: The new rules for the independent military newspaper are the Defense Department's latest effort to put extraordinary restrictions on journalists covering the agency.

item.title: See the Oscars red carpet looks
item.summary: Stars are arriving for the Academy Awards. The show starts at 7 p.m. ET, 4 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.

item.title: Israeli soldiers fire on family car in occupied West Bank, killing 4
item.summary: Israeli soldiers fired on a car carrying a family in the northern West Bank, killing four people including two children, the Palestinian Authority's Health Ministry said.

item.title: Selection Sunday: Duke No. 1 overall in men's tournament, UConn women get top seed
item.summary: Duke will be the top overall seed in the men's NCAA basketball tournament. In the women's, the top-ranked UConn Huskies are undefeated and hope to repeat as champions for the first time in a decade.

item.title: Snow and wind batter parts of US, with threat of thunderstorms and tornadoes
item.summary: A broad and erratic patchwork of severe weather rumbled across much of the U.S. on Sunday, dumping heavy snow in the Upper Midwest while damaging high winds swept across the Plains.

item.title: Sunday Puzzle: BAD!
item.summary: Ayesha Rascoe plays the puzzle with KCUR listener Justin Marciniak and Weekend Edition Puzzlemaster Will Shortz.

item.title: Why the Chicago Bears could be moving to Indiana
item.summary: While Illinois is trying to keep the team in Chicago's suburbs, Indiana lawmakers are offering a plan to finance a new stadium
